title: hegel panics at init without a user cache dir, blocking any HOME-stripped gate
description:
Under HOME=<empty> every test in internal/forge and internal/profile panics at init: 'write libhegel: resolve user cache dir: $HOME is not defined'. The property-test library resolves a user cache dir at package init, before any test can construct a condition. This is why the gate's stripped environment is git-scoped rather than the note's original HOME=<empty> recipe; it would also block anyone taking the gate further.
evidence: env HOME= go test ./internal/forge/ — panic in hegel.dev/go/hegel/internal/libhegel init.func1, libhegel.go:558
